# One army slot. $TAG$ = army tag register, $LEVY$ = levy loss per mille, $Tk$/$Sk$ = MaA type index / survivor
# share of max per mille. Depletion also cuts MaA (seen in game), so MaA are set exactly afterwards.
ck3xbl_apply_army_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:$TAG$ > 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = ck3xbl_armies
			limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_aid var:ck3xbl_aid = root.var:$TAG$ }
			if = { limit = { root.var:$LEVY$ > 0 } deplete_army_by_percentage = { value = root.var:$LEVY$ divide = 1000 } }
			ck3xbl_apply_maa_pair_effect = { TYPE = $T1$ SHARE = $S1$ }
			ck3xbl_apply_maa_pair_effect = { TYPE = $T2$ SHARE = $S2$ }
			ck3xbl_apply_maa_pair_effect = { TYPE = $T3$ SHARE = $S3$ }
			ck3xbl_apply_maa_pair_effect = { TYPE = $T4$ SHARE = $S4$ }
			ck3xbl_apply_maa_pair_effect = { TYPE = $T5$ SHARE = $S5$ }
			ck3xbl_apply_maa_pair_effect = { TYPE = $T6$ SHARE = $S6$ }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_a_tag value = var:ck3xbl_aid }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_after value = army_size }
			info_log = "CK3XBL|RES|A"
			info_log_scopes = yes
		}
	}
}

# One award slot (PROTOCOL 13.5). $TAG$ / $AWARD$ = registers holding the character tag and the award value
# A = R + 10 G + 1000 P. The alive character with that tag gets:
# 25 x P prestige, 5 x G glory to an acclaimed knight's accolade, R rolls of the vanilla knight prowess chance; then RES|AW.
ck3xbl_apply_award_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:$TAG$ > 0 var:$AWARD$ > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_aw_p value = { value = var:$AWARD$ divide = 1000 floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_aw_g value = { value = var:$AWARD$ modulo = 1000 divide = 10 floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_aw_r value = { value = var:$AWARD$ modulo = 10 } }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = ck3xbl_chars
			limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_tag var:ck3xbl_tag = root.var:$TAG$ is_alive = yes }
			if = { limit = { root.var:ck3xbl_aw_p > 0 } add_prestige = { value = root.var:ck3xbl_aw_p multiply = 25 } }
			if = { limit = { root.var:ck3xbl_aw_g > 0 is_acclaimed = yes } accolade = { add_glory = { value = root.var:ck3xbl_aw_g multiply = 5 } } }
			if = { limit = { root.var:ck3xbl_aw_r >= 1 } knight_increase_prowess_chance_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { root.var:ck3xbl_aw_r >= 2 } knight_increase_prowess_chance_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { root.var:ck3xbl_aw_r >= 3 } knight_increase_prowess_chance_effect = yes }
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_aw_tag value = var:$TAG$ }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_aw_value value = var:$AWARD$ }
		info_log = "CK3XBL|RES|AW"
		info_log_scopes = yes
		remove_variable = ck3xbl_aw_p
		remove_variable = ck3xbl_aw_g
		remove_variable = ck3xbl_aw_r
	}
}

# Summary for event ck3xbl_battle.0003 and the prestige bonus. The numbers are saved values (scope:ck3xbl_res_*), which
# the battle clock copies onto the steered armies; the player variables ck3xbl_res_* that 0003 reads are written now unless
# a steered battle (payload 4, outcomes 1..3) applies while the summary window of an earlier one is open (ck3xbl_res_showing):
# that window reads them live, and ck3xbl_clock.0003 writes them when it opens the next one.
ck3xbl_apply_summary_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_my_lost value = var:ck3xbl_r4 }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_enemy_lost value = var:ck3xbl_r5 }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_my_kills value = { value = var:ck3xbl_r6 modulo = 1000 } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_feats2 value = { value = var:ck3xbl_r6 divide = 1000 floor = yes } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_won value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:ck3xbl_res_winner_code > 0 scope:ck3xbl_res_winner_code = scope:ck3xbl_res_my_side }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_won value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { var:ck3xbl_r0 = 4 }
				scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome = 4
				NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_res_showing }
			}
		}
		ck3xbl_write_summary_effect = yes
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_prestige value = { value = var:ck3xbl_r7 modulo = 226 } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_res_feats value = { value = var:ck3xbl_r7 subtract = scope:ck3xbl_res_prestige divide = 226 floor = yes } }
	if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_res_prestige > 0 scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome >= 1 scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome <= 3 } add_prestige = scope:ck3xbl_res_prestige }
	if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_res_feats > 0 scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome >= 1 scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome <= 2 } ck3xbl_apply_feats_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_res_feats2 > 0 scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome >= 1 scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome <= 2 } ck3xbl_apply_feats2_effect = yes }
}

# The summary values of ck3xbl_apply_summary_effect into the player variables ck3xbl_res_* of event ck3xbl_battle.0003.
ck3xbl_write_summary_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_res_outcome value = scope:ck3xbl_res_outcome }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_res_my_lost value = scope:ck3xbl_res_my_lost }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_res_enemy_lost value = scope:ck3xbl_res_enemy_lost }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_res_my_kills value = scope:ck3xbl_res_my_kills }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_res_won value = scope:ck3xbl_res_won }
}

# this = regiment: current = max * share / 1000 (share divided first to keep the product small)
ck3xbl_set_maa_share_effect = {
	change_maa_troops_count = {
		value = root.var:$SHARE$
		divide = 1000
		multiply = maa_max_troops_count
		subtract = maa_current_troops_count
	}
}
